title: Detention and Demurrage Invoice Verifier
tagline: A container can be late while the invoice is still addressed to the wrong party or sent too late.

cards: Operational lateness makes every charge seem collectible.
Party and clock are separate gates
A factually late box can still produce an invalid invoice path.
The wrong party pays a late or duplicate bill.
Every dollar remains traceable before review or dispute.

story.headline: The late container with the day-31 invoice
beats: A container accumulates charges after its free-time period.
The invoice facts look correct but issuance occurs on day 31.
The agent treats cargo lateness as proof that the invoice is payable.
The clock gate holds payment and prepares an exact dispute receipt.
